insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput, allowing multiple tracking numbers to be attached to a fulfillment when importing orders. This change is available in the GraphQL Admin API.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This will enable them to attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment. No migration is required, but developers should test their code to ensure compatibility with the updated API. The GraphQL Admin API will continue to support the existing orderCreate mutation, but developers should use the new field to take advantage of the enhanced functionality.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, which can improve customer satisfaction and reduce support queries.
insight.why_it_matters: This change matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, which is essential for merchants to manage their fulfillment operations efficiently. It also demonstrates Shopify's commitment to enhancing its APIs to meet the evolving needs of merchants and developers.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: Hydrogen CLI now supports a new flag --javascript-origin to override the default dev origin. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in Vite request conversion.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Hydrogen customer account login recovery has been improved, and OAuth state values now use cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit, and dependencies have been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, including updating cart attributes and firing a new event when an attributes update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory holds for draft orders, transfers, and shipments are being consolidated from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory is represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more flexible order importing.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion highlight the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as new flags, HTTP/2 support, and enhanced security. The skeleton package also saw updates, recommending the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query this data on behalf of authorized merchants using the existing ShopifyQL schema, specifically the shop_campaign_insights schema.
